newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares up ahead of Reliance news.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares up ahead of Reliance news.

text.p: Heavy trading in Reliance Industries Ltd ahead of annual results led a charge as share prices quoted sharply higher in early afternoon trade on the Delhi bourse on Tuesday, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index was 6.19 points higher at 798.73 at 12:45 p.m. (0715 GMT).
"For the moment, the market's only concern seems to be the results of Reliance Industries," said one broker.
"Heavy buying on hopes of better than expected results by Reliance Industries has sent the share prices higher," said Shree Bhagwan Garg of brokers Means Leasing.
Reliance Industries, India's largest private company, later announced that its profit rose to 13.23 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) from 13.05 billion in the previous year.
The petrochemicals giant said its sales rose to 87.3 billion rupees in 1996/97 from 77.86 billion. The company also announced a dividend of 6.50 rupees per share.
State Bank of India quoted 1.00 rupee higher at 312.25.
